name: Weblooks Writer – AI Writer, SEO Content & Auto Blogging
author: sauvage7

sections.description:
Turn your website’s knowledge into your next useful blog post. Weblooks Writer is an AI article writer and content planner for WordPress: choose relevant topics, generate a draft from your website’s content, improve it with a simple prompt, and review it in the WordPress editor.

Start with one free article. No credit card required. Your first article includes two successful AI improvements and draft delivery or optional automatic publication, so you can try the complete writing workflow before subscribing.

An AI writer with your website as its starting point

Import selected public pages and posts, then confirm your business facts, audience, language and exclusions. Generate articles about the topics your website actually covers, with source links and contextual internal links for readers to explore.

Improve a section without starting over

Ask for a clearer explanation, a different tone or a practical example. Improve one section or the whole article, preview the proposed change, and accept or undo it. Continue editing manually in Gutenberg.

Plan content and stay in control

Plan one to six months ahead, with one to three articles on selected days. Choose WordPress drafts or optional automatic publishing. Your free article can publish automatically without prior approval. For ongoing publication on a paid plan, approve one example and enable automation; later eligible articles go public without individual approval. Quality checks can hold articles, and the service asks for more information when distinct useful topics run out.

Free sample and paid writing service

A Weblooks Writer account is required. The plugin is free and connects to the Weblooks hosted writing service. After your free sample, further AI articles and their scheduled delivery require a paid service subscription. See current plans. Existing WordPress posts and normal manual editing remain available if you cancel the service or remove the plugin. The plugin’s local code is fully included.

Writing for readers and search engines

Use Weblooks Writer to support your SEO content workflow with relevant topics, clear articles and useful internal links. AI can make mistakes: check facts, sources, rights and suitability before publication. More articles do not automatically mean better rankings. There are no ranking, traffic, revenue or universal compatibility guarantees. Automatic quality checks do not replace qualified human review. Use draft mode for regulated advice or media/journalism requiring that review. Automatically published articles include an AI-origin notice.

External services and privacy

The plugin connects to https://writer.weblooks.ch, operated by Weblooks GmbH, Switzerland. Before the first service request, an administrator must choose to enable the connection. Existing signed-in administrators have already connected. There is no advertising or optional analytics without consent.

Requests go from your WordPress server to the hosted service over HTTPS:

  • Sign-in/registration sends the account email and entered password for authentication. The plugin does not store your password. An encrypted, expiring service session is stored separately for each WordPress administrator.
  • Import and connection send your site address and selected public pages/posts. Private, draft and password-protected posts are excluded from source sync.
  • Generation and improvements send requested article text, prompts and selected sources. The hosted service uses Anthropic for AI processing. Do not submit confidential, sensitive or children’s personal data.
  • Delivery transfers the article, source links, title cover or approved image, and metadata to WordPress as a draft or public post according to your selected mode. Signed delivery requests and receipts prevent duplicate imports.
  • Billing opens Stripe-hosted Checkout or the customer portal in a separate tab. Card details are entered with Stripe; they are not stored in WordPress or the writing service.
  • The service uses Resend for account/service emails, Cyon for hosting and Cloudflare for network delivery/security. Providers may process data internationally.

Service: https://writer.weblooks.ch
Terms: https://weblooks.ch/legal/wordpress-writer/terms.html
Privacy: https://weblooks.ch/legal/wordpress-writer/privacy.html
Support: hello@weblooks.ch

Source code and build instructions

All human-readable plugin source is included in this ZIP under GPLv2 or later. The editable dashboard sources are src/app.js, src/content.mjs, src/style.css, src/dashboard-overrides.css and src/index.html. PHP, assets/editor.js and assets/dashboard-loader.js are maintained directly as unminified source.

To rebuild the generated assets with Node.js 24 or newer, run node tools/build-dashboard.mjs from the extracted plugin directory. Run node tools/build-dashboard.mjs --check to verify the result. No dependencies, private repository access or network connection are required. src/BUILD.md documents the source-to-asset mapping and build steps.
sections.installation:
1. Install and activate Weblooks Writer.
  2. Click Create your free article in the activation notice or plugin row (or open Writer), read the service disclosure and choose Enable writing service.
  3. Create or sign in to your Writer account and verify your email.
  4. Import your website, confirm the business facts and create your free sample.
  5. In Publishing, connect this WordPress website. Your imported site address must match this website for article delivery.
  6. Send your free sample to WordPress drafts, or open Publishing, select Automatic publishing, choose a time, confirm the explanation, uncheck Pause and save. No subscription or card is needed for this first article. Choose a plan in Billing for further articles and scheduled delivery.

Use one Writer installation per WordPress website. If migrating from the private WordPress Writer test package, follow the migration instructions supplied by Weblooks before deleting the old plugin; deleting it clears the shared service connection and sign-in.
sections.faq:
Is a credit card required for the free sample?

No. The hosted service offers one free sample per eligible website/account, with two included successful AI improvements. Draft delivery or optional automatic publication of your free sample is included. Further articles require a subscription.

Can I edit just one section?

Yes. Select a section in Writer or a block in Gutenberg, describe the improvement, and review the proposed change before accepting. Published articles remain manually editable in WordPress.

What happens when I cancel?

Normal subscription cancellation stops renewal and retains paid service until the end of the paid period. Immediate cancellation/account deletion ends access immediately. Posts and media already delivered to WordPress stay on your website.

Can I use this as an AI blog post generator?

Yes. Import your site’s public content, confirm the website profile, choose a topic and generate an article. You can improve the result in Writer and deliver it to WordPress as a draft. An account is required; the first sample is free and further generation requires a subscription.

Does it automatically publish articles?

Yes, including your free article without a card or prior article approval. Create your free article, connect WordPress, then open Publishing, select Automatic publishing, choose a time, confirm the explanation, uncheck Pause and save. Ongoing publication requires an active paid plan and an approved example under Content. Later eligible articles publish at your selected times without individual approval. Draft mode remains the default; existing draft schedules do not change. Quality issues, an expired allowance, payment problems or a disconnected site can pause delivery. Only the one free article is published without a subscription.

Will this improve my Google rankings?

No outcome is guaranteed. Use the service to create useful, accurate content for your readers. More articles do not automatically mean better rankings.

Which WordPress installations are supported?

WordPress 6.2 or newer, PHP 7.4 or newer, HTTPS and outbound HTTPS access to the writing service. The service must be able to reach this site’s WordPress REST API. Firewalls/security plugins may need configuration. One website per Writer account; multisite/network activation is not supported. These are compatibility minimums: we recommend current WordPress and a PHP release that still receives security updates.
sections.changelog:
0.3.16

  • Enter a website without typing https:// and use Show password during signup.
  • Verification links now last 24 hours; clearer recovery when a connection fails.
  • Preserve visible error feedback if account loading fails after sign-in.

0.3.15

  • Go straight from enabling Writer to free-account signup.
  • Return to WordPress after email confirmation; verification is detected automatically.
  • Clearer expired-link recovery, resend confirmation and setup progress.

0.3.14

  • Preserve the website entered during signup through email verification.
  • Guide new users through account verification, website confirmation and their first article.
  • Suggest article ideas directly after confirming a new profile.
  • Improve sign-in and registration guidance and password autofill.

0.3.13

  • Show WordPress draft or Published from the actual WordPress post status.
  • Refresh public links and show the correct action after manual WordPress changes.
  • Handle private, protected, deleted and unreachable posts without a misleading publish button.

0.3.12

  • Keep a visible publishing indicator open until WordPress confirms publication.
  • Prevent repeated clicks while publishing and restore controls after errors.

0.3.11

  • Publish ready articles immediately from Your content, including your free article.
  • Publish an existing WordPress draft without duplicating it or replacing manual edits.
  • Keep other scheduled articles unchanged; confirm public visibility before publishing.

0.3.10

  • Support WordPress 6.2+ and PHP 7.4+, with expanded compatibility checks.
  • Add a first-activation notice and a direct setup link in the plugins list.
  • Keep external-service consent and free-article eligibility unchanged.

0.3.9

  • Include opt-in automatic publication of the free article without a card or prior article approval.
  • Keep additional articles paid, with account/site-bound eligibility, quality holds and duplicate-safe retries.

0.3.8

  • Offer opt-in automatic publication on paid plans, with clear setup and AI-origin disclosure.
  • Keep draft delivery as the default and the free sample as a WordPress draft.
  • Preserve upcoming topic order when changing delivery settings.

0.3.7

  • Send eligible articles to WordPress drafts manually while your schedule is paused.
  • Clear action-error dialogs explain how to recover without losing your work.

0.3.6

  • Preserve upgrade ledgers with older SQLite integrations using exact table-name discovery.

0.3.5

  • Bundle complete editable dashboard sources and a standalone reproducible build script.
  • Use the distinctive weblwr / WEBLWR prefix for plugin identifiers and stored records.
  • Automatically preserve existing connections, encrypted sessions, article metadata and delivery/replay ledgers during upgrade.

0.3.4

  • Show clear plan choices after starting the free sample and when requesting additional articles.
  • Keep the free article accessible, disclose immediate recurring payment, and route existing subscribers to Billing.
  • Preserve payment error status in the WordPress dashboard.

0.3.3

  • Include WordPress draft delivery with the free sample, without a subscription or card.
  • Clarify the free offer in the dashboard and service terms.

0.3.2

  • Paid-service terms include the customer data-processing agreement.
  • Live launch supports explicitly owner-managed tax accounting and isolated payment notifications.

0.3.1

  • Clarifies free sample and paid WordPress delivery limits.
  • Shows tax-inclusive prices consistently and handles closed registration.

0.3.0

  • Public Weblooks Writer package and explicit service connection disclosure.
  • Preparation for production signup, billing and launch validation.
  • Includes the 0.2.5 payment return, canceled allowance and uncropped cover fixes.
